items.title: FSRCNN
items.description: Prescaler based on layered convolutional networks.

items.title: nnedi3 and ravu
items.description: User shaders for prescaling.

items.title: AniSD ArtCNN
items.description: AniSD ArtCNN shader for standard definition anime content.

items.title: Ani4K v2 ArtCNN
items.description: Ani4K shader v2 targets modern anime, from high quality Bluray to crappy WEB releases, for upscaling to either 2K or 4K.

items.title: ArtCNN
items.description: Luma doublers trained on Manga109.

items.title: hdr-toys
items.description: Componentized Rec.2100 to Rec.709 conversion shader.

items.title: CuNNy
items.description: Cute and funny CNN-based upscaler optimized for anime.

items.title: A-Pack
items.description: Shaders pack for quick Adjustment of (web) video: brightness/contrast curves (tooDark, tooBright, bShadows, bDim, etc.) and color (vibrance, skintones, Black&White). Runs on integrated graphics.

items.title: Noise
items.description: Simplistic filter that adds a tunable amount of uniform white noise to the output.

items.title: Antiringing
items.description: This is an antiringing filter that works by clamping to the local neighbourhood. Sort of inspired by the mpv built-in antiringing algorithm, but it's extended in such a way that it also works well for polar (EWA) filters, which the mpv built-in algorithm does not support at all.

items.title: nlmeans, hdeband, & more
items.description: nlmeans is a featureful implementation of the Non-local Means algorithm, it does both denoising and adaptive sharpening. hdeband is an implementation of a debanding algorithm that blurs homogeneous regions together.

items.title: JointBilateral & FastBilateral
items.description: Chroma upsamplers that use the luma plane as a guide to achieve sharper transitions without introducing any ringing.

items.title: Pixel Clipper
items.description: Simple anti-ringing filter based on pixel clipping/clamping.

items.title: Alt Scale
items.description: An alternative to mpv's built in scaling. It can be slightly faster than built in scaling with equivalent quality.

items.title: Jinc
items.description: Jinc based image scaling. Similar to mpv's ewa or polar.

items.title: Post upscale unsharp masking
items.description: This is mpvs original image sharpening algorithm ported into the shader, in order to work only after upscaling is done.

items.title: Unsharp mask and Gaussian blur
items.description: A 2 pass unsharp mask and a 2 pass gaussian blur. Similar to those in Photoshop, Image Magick, Gimp, etc.

items.title: 2D Image Resampling
items.description: 2D Image Resampling is a general resampling algorithm made for experimental / testing use.

items.title: NLS-Next
items.description: A nonlinear stretch shader and helper script for MPV, featuring bi-directional stretching and multiple tunable options.

items.title: mvtools
items.description: Use MVTools's BlockFPS function to perform motion interpolation on the video in realtime.

items.title: nnedi3
items.description: Use NNEDI3 to double the resolution of the video. This always performs a single doubling. Note that the vapoursynth-nnedi3 filter is so slow that this practically can't be used in realtime, so it's not much use in practice.
